questions.answer: Other

questions.question: Please explain: *
questions.answer: Der er gode muligheder for at surfe og kitesurfe i Perth. Derfor tog jeg dertil.

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der var andre gode kitesurfere, så jeg kunne træne samtidig med at jeg fortsatte min uddannelse.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Perth er et fantastisk sted.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Nemt. Der er god service på UWA. De har ansatte der udelukkende tager sig af study abroad studerende. De svarer på mails samme dag man har sendt dem.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Fik hjælp til hvordan jeg skulle indskrive mig på mine valgte fag.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Det her var meget svært for de fleste. Alle udvekslingsstuderende ankom midt i en "rent crisis", hvilket betød, at der var få muligheder, og at det var dyrt at finde et sted at bo. Jeg var virkelig heldig, at en af de lokale kitesurfere skulle til Europa, så jeg overtog hans værelse.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Jeg vil anbefale at leve off-campus, men fald ikke i fælden og lej et værelse på et af de store "student housings" i Perth! De hedder henholdsvis "The Bouleward", "The Switch" og "Campus Perth". De steder er IKKE på campus og er totalt overpriced. Desuden kræver de, at man betaler husleje indtil slut januar. Samtidig er der ikke særlig socialt. Hvis man skal bo off-campus skal man finde sit eget sted enten med nogle af de andre udvekslingsstuderende eller med lokale.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:

Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Totalt nemt, fleksibelt og god service. Man kan ombestemme sig op til en uge efter at semesteret er startet.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Drop in and mail.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Fik alle units jeg ville have.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Don't worry

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Det faglige niveau er lavere end på KU. Hvis man bare vil bestå fagene er det peace of cake.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Havde ét 1. års fag, ét 2. års fag og to 3. års fag.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer:
Der var ikke plads til lige så meget fordybning som på KU. Vi lærte meget om mange emner, men det var overfladisk.
Mere kontakt med professoren. Færre timer på uni, men også mindre arbejde helt generelt.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Environmental Economics, 
Game Theory and Strategic Thinking, 
Applied Macroeconomics og 
Derivative Products and Markets

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Hvis du er polit-studerende skal du helt klart have "Game Theory and Strategic Thinking" og "Applied Macroeconomics". De giver merit for mikro 3 og makro 3.

Environmental Economics giver merit for prioriteret valgfag.

Til sidst vil jeg anbefale faget "Active Leadership". Mange af de andre udvekslingsstuderende havde det, og det er det nemmeste i verden. Man kan vælge mellem at cykle, ro i kajak eller stå på stand up paddle.

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Fik kun visa til slut December, men ville gerne blive her til Januar, så skal købe nyt visa til 2000kr.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer:
Priserne er sikkert også steget i DK, men alt er dyrt hernede. Den billigste kasse øl koster 200 kr. og mad er også dyrt.

Benzin er billigt (7,5kr/literen), og det selvom vi er midt i en energikrise. Det er også billigt at spise ude.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Der tilbydes en lang række gratis sportsaktiviter. Jeg meldte mig til det hele, men endte kun med at spille lidt tennis. Super muligheder dog!

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Alt tænkeligt. Festerne på uni er til gengæld elendige. Nattelivet i Perth er heller ikke imponerende. Jeg havde de sjoveste aftener i Fremantle.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Tennis fordi de har gode faciliteter.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer:
Køb en bil og tag på roadtrip! 
Exmouth/Kalbarri/Geraldton/Coral Bay/Lancelin i nord og Margaret River/Denmark/Albany/Esperance i syd.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer:
Nemt. Australiere er flinke.

Når man er i byen skal man passe lidt på. Nogle af dem vil meget gerne slås.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Det bedste er at bo med dem. Ellers meld dig ind i et fælleskab. Sportsklub eller lignende er en god start.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Hvis der står en bajle med is og øl til en fest er det IKKE til alle. Alle tager sine egne drikkevarer med til fest.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer:
Deres åbenhed. Alle er altid velkomne til deres arrangementer, hvilket typisk er barbecues.

Deres kærlighed til deres natur. De tager altid på roadtrip og camper nogle nice steder.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Sørg for at anskaffe dig en bil. Det giver så mange muligheder og vil gøre dit ophold 10 gange federe.

Sørg for at have en god opsparing med, så du har råd til at have det sjovt.

Kom herned med rejselyst. Perth er ikke så spændene en by, men naturen omkring er fantastisk. For alle australiere hernede handler det om at komme ud til stranden og ud i naturen. Semesteret slutter allerede start/midt November, så derefter er der 2,5 måned til at rejse rundt i Australien.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Tag noget varmt tøj med. Det bliver koldt om aftenen.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At møde de lokale australiere og leve deres liv for en stund.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Det sværeste var, at jeg ikke havde min kæreste med. Derudover var det svært i starten, hvor jeg ikke havde fundet et sted at bo endnu. Jeg boede på et elendigt hostel, men det varede heldigvis kun 5 dage. Det var også svært at bruge så mange penge, men det var 100% det værd.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
